message: No detected input validation: The code uses argparse for CLI parsing and assert_for_log for some logical checks, but there is no explicit validation of input data structure, types, or value ranges on the data acquisition path.
No detected untrusted source handling: ELMO model files are fetched from a hardcoded S3 URL with no checksum verification, signature check, or pinned revision to authenticate the remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline performs tokenization and indexing but includes no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model states and pretrained weights (e.g., ELMo weights via URL, HuggingFace transformers) without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: No imports or usage of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any differential privacy mechanism are present.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial attack/stress-test logic are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation from training data at evaluation time, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics as a cross-check against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path only parses CLI arguments and loads configs via argparse/HOCON; there are no input shape, range, or schema validation checks on data passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the pipeline handles text tasks (NLI, QA, etc.), there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection anywhere in the visible code.
